compare_note: parts = speechParts(reply, lang) (server/tts.js, the producer the page reads from, as FX-013); each part -> POST /api/speak {text, lang} in order, the next sent after the previous answered (unless the case says 'queued'). voice_used = the `voice` field of the server's tts_done log line for that part (03 DES-041 step 4: the voice the reader reports it used). 01: a case-run is valid only if every part's voice_used equals the voice set for it (setup check, not scored: it decides nothing about Q31). number_heard = the number part's transcript, NFKC + lowercase, with Latin digit words replaced as whole words (zero/oh 0, one 1, two 2, three 3, four 4, five 5, six 6, seven 7, eight 8, nine 9) and the Han digits 零〇 0, 一幺 1, 二两 2, 三 3, 四 4, 五 5, 六 6, 七 7, 八 8, 九 9 replaced, then every non-digit removed: true when the digit string contains the reply's number (988 or 12356). 02: answers in order of n = status of each POST /api/speak and its voice_used; answered_once_each = exactly one tts_done line per part and one response per request; answered_in_order = tts_done lines and responses arrive in n order.
